summary: No fundamentals thesis is broken. All three single-stock holdings (DPZ, IDXX, WMT) were opened today and the book is down only $0.04 (agent -0.007% vs SPY +0.335%), a one-day move that is not evidence against any thesis. DPZ closed about 3.6% above its entry-day reference with a $274.88 stop untouched, IDXX is +0.38% against a $500.22 stop, and WMT is -0.24% against a 7% stop. The fundamentals-based invalidations (cfo below net income, falling off the screen) cannot be tested until the next fundamentals refresh. Note: inputs/learning.json was not present in the run directory, so no lessons or graded calls were applied.
